title: Digital Arrest Scam (ડિજિટલ અરેસ્ટ)
description: Caller impersonates Mumbai Crime Branch police inspector, claims narcotics parcel seized in victim's name, threatens arrest, orders victim into isolation room, and demands ₹1,50,000 security deposit.

title: Electricity Bill Disconnection Scam (વીજળી બિલ)
description: Urgent warning that electricity power will be disconnected at 9:30 PM tonight due to unpaid bill update. Caller pressures victim to immediately share 6-digit OTP to prevent blackout.

title: Fake Bank Lottery Scam (SBI લોટરી ઇનામ)
description: Caller congratulates elderly user on winning a ₹25,00,000 government lucky draw, requiring an upfront processing fee of ₹5,000 via UPI within 30 minutes.

title: Genuine Bank Support (બેંક કસ્ટમર કેર)
description: Customer care representative verifying branch query and address update. Explicitly reminds the customer that bank staff never asks for OTP or CVV. Never reaches scam verdict.
